ja: 田中さんのコードにミスを見つけた。
en: I found a mistake in Tanaka's code.
alternatives: I noticed a mistake in Tanaka's code.
I spotted a mistake in Tanaka's code.
point: 「見つけた」は find の過去形 found

ja: 手直しは要るけど、構成はすごくいいよ。
en: Although it needs work, the structure's great.
alternatives: It needs some work, but the structure's great.
The structure's great, even though it needs work.
point: although を使ったら後ろに but を重ねない

ja: リーダーの指摘、もっと早く聞けばよかった。
en: I wish I'd listened to my lead's feedback sooner.
alternatives: If only I'd listened to my lead's feedback earlier.
I should've taken my lead's feedback on board sooner.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish I had + 過去分詞

ja: 次の提案書、出す前に誰かに見てもらうといいかも。
en: Maybe have someone review the next proposal before submitting.
alternatives: Maybe get someone to check the next proposal before sending.
You could have someone check the next proposal before sending.
point: have + 人 + 動詞の原形で「人に〜してもらう」

ja: 最近、コードをすごく丁寧に見てくれるね。
en: You've been reviewing my code so carefully lately.
alternatives: You've been reviewing my code really carefully recently.
You've been so careful reviewing my code lately.
point: 「最近ずっと〜している」は have been doing で表す

ja: 明日の朝までにコメントを送ります。
en: I'll send my comments by tomorrow morning.
alternatives: I'll send my feedback by tomorrow morning.
You'll have my comments by tomorrow morning.
point: 「〜までに」は until ではなく by

ja: 最後にまとめスライドは考えてみた？
en: Have you considered adding a summary slide?
alternatives: Have you thought about a summary slide?
Did you consider adding a summary slide?
point: consider の後は add ではなく adding

ja: 指摘されたスライド、もう全部直しました。
en: I've already fixed all the slides you flagged.
alternatives: I've already fixed every slide you pointed out.
All the slides you flagged are fixed already.
point: 「もう直した」は現在完了、slides の後ろに you flagged を続ける

ja: お客さんが、週報を短くしてほしいって。
en: The client wants us to shorten weekly reports.
alternatives: The client wants the weekly reports shorter.
The client wants us to trim weekly reports.
point: 「〜してほしい」は want + 人 + to do で表す

ja: 報告書、正確なだけでなく、とても分かりやすかったです。
en: Not only was it accurate, it was easy to follow.
alternatives: It was not only accurate but also easy to follow.
It wasn't just accurate; it was easy to follow.
point: Not only を文頭に出したら was it と語順を倒す

ja: ここにミスが二つあります。
alternatives: I see two mistakes here.
There are two errors here.
point: 複数のミスなので There is ではなく There are

ja: 何かアドバイスをもらえますか？
en: Could you give me some advice?
alternatives: Can you give me some advice?
Do you have any advice for me?
point: advice は数えられないので an advice や advices にしない
